body: Triage (2026-06-27, for 11.0 epic #2364): **OPEN — small fix.** `pickRecordDisplayName()` (objectui `packages/fields/src/index.tsx`) already accepts `preferredField`, but the 5 `LookupCellRenderer` call sites never pass the target object's `displayNameField`, so non-`name` displays fall back to the hardcoded candidate list (raw IDs). Fix = thread metadata `displayNameField` into the cell renderer + dev warning on ID fallback.
